caption: The drawing shows a cylindrical lantern with a metallic, grayish-silver frame composed of two circular plates at the top and bottom, connected by six slender vertical rods. The body of the lantern appears to be made of a translucent material, possibly glass, held securely between the plates. The top plate is decorated with a circular, raised rim and contains embossed lettering. Attached to the top of the lantern is a wooden handle, which is light brown and attached to the lantern by two angled metal wires fixed to the corners of the plate. The drawing is on an off-white background, and in the bottom left corner, the name "LESTER H. KROUCH." is written in black.
title: Combined Stove and Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
